purpose: Machine-readable epistemic classification records for all active, prototype, and research models across Oklo Pool Mobile and Planetary Explorer v2.
rules: Every model rendered or cited must carry an epistemic record conforming to the 6 evidence classes.
No model evidence class may be promoted by visual proximity to geographic or empirical datasets.
Synthetic transport models must never be represented as calibrated historical subsurface reconstructions.
Units and coordinate systems must be explicitly declared; cross-coordinate operations without adapters are forbidden.

models.uncertainty: Surface geographic coordinates localized to roughly 100 meters horizontal accuracy.
models.known_limitations: Locates the modern Oklo uranium deposit on the contemporary African plate in Gabon (1.4000 S, 13.1833 E). Does not depict Paleoproterozoic paleogeography at 2.0 Ga, which requires independent continental reconstruction models.

models.uncertainty: Reported 30-minute active pulse and roughly 2.5-hour cooling dormancy cycle derived from xenon retention ratios in aluminum phosphate crystals.
models.known_limitations: Empirical isotopic retention measurement from Oklo ore specimens. While the cyclic thermal-hydraulic mechanism is physically motivated, the geochemical record reflects integrated mineral formation rather than direct real-time instrumentation.

models.specification_version: Bodu et al. 1972 and Neuilly et al. 1972
models.uncertainty: Depletion measured by mass spectrometry from normal baseline 0.00725 down to approximately 0.004 in reactor core facies.
models.known_limitations: Discrete drill-core and pit sample assay measurements. Depletion is spatially heterogeneous across reactor zones; localized measurements do not describe continuous spatial fields without interpolation.

models.uncertainty: Field mapping and drill core logs with resolution on the scale of decimeters to meters.
models.known_limitations: Geological borehole logs and open-pit structural maps specific to the Francevillian FA-FB sedimentary boundary. Local stratigraphy cannot be directly generalized to other sedimentary basins without field verification.
Prescribed algebraic formula evaluating temperature as a function of vertical index k/32 and radial core/conduit indicators. Not a thermal-hydraulic or energy-conservation physical simulation.
Prescribed desiccation curve scaling pore saturation between 0.02 and 1.0. Not a two-phase unsaturated flow, Richards equation, or multiphase steam-water transport solution.
Dimensionless radiolytic proxy index. G-value alone without dose rate, dose integration, and diffusive transport cannot yield physical chemical concentrations.
Prescribed spatial depletion gradient anchored at natural baseline 0.00725. Atom ratio is not interchangeable with 0.7204 atom percent. Not a solved neutronics or burnup calculation.

Prescribed heuristic field. The revision-0 fixture labels this quantity in umol/L, but no kinetic or thermodynamic basis for those concentration units is established. Values are not measured or predicted polymer concentrations, and its mass balance closes by construction (Finding R0-8); not evidence of prebiotic polymer synthesis, polymerization kinetics, or RNA formation.
Prescribed categorical zone indicators (0=Sandstone, 1=Core, 2=Halo, 3=Conduit, 4=Steam Chimney). Schematic geometry, not surveyed subsurface geology or mapped fracture networks.

models.uncertainty: Unquantified temperature error at 300 C due to uncorrected Robertson 1988 thermal conductivity; interface check D3a reached relative error 2.58e-10 vs 1e-10 tolerance.
models.known_limitations: Hypothetical steady Darcy flow on idealized 16m cube geometry. Does not describe historical Oklo hydrogeology. Pore velocities use unsourced flow porosities except core. Single-phase liquid only; does not model steam boiling.

models.uncertainty: Linear sorption Kd swept across 7 orders of magnitude (0 to 630 m3/kg) as EPA sensitivity bounds rather than site-specific Gabon measurements.
models.known_limitations: Synthetic 1D column; not a reconstruction of Oklo or the Franceville Basin. Constant reducing capacity assumed; no mineral precipitation kinetics, competitive complexation, or 3D hydrodynamic dispersion.

models.uncertainty: Uncalibrated physical time and length scales; seconds_per_mcs is NaN.
models.known_limitations: Cellular Potts discrete model tokens, not real biological organisms. Coupled radiodialysis path BLOCKED at MCS 1 due to unit inconsistency between lattice indices and physical PDE operators. Read-only architectural reference.

models.uncertainty: Synthetic spatial protection toy; error-threshold radiation selection hypothesis falsified and unvalidated under realistic copying fidelities (Spec 14).
models.known_limitations: Zero RNA chemistry, zero nucleotide thermodynamics, and zero polymerization kinetics. Not an RNA-world simulation or evidence for historical abiogenesis. Methodological reference for 5-term mass ledgers only.

models.uncertainty: Reported self-TM-score (0.50934) is repository-reported only and not independently benchmarked.
models.known_limitations: C1-prime backbone coordinate representation only; lacks full-atom ribose-phosphate geometry. Solver decoupled from client rendering; static precomputed coordinate table only, zero mobile inference.

models.specification_version: Ebisuzaki and Maruyama 2017 / Adam et al. 2018
models.uncertainty: Uncalibrated kinetic rate constants under high-radiation Paleoproterozoic hydrothermal conditions.
models.known_limitations: Theoretical hypothesis positing that periodic geyser dehydration concentrates nucleotide precursors and drives oligomerization. Unproven in natural nuclear reactor geochemical settings.

models.uncertainty: Falsified under empirical non-enzymatic RNA replication error rates (approx 7.6 percent per base); required baseline error rate sitting below literature bounds.
models.known_limitations: Hypothetical model positing that spatial ionizing radiation gradients select for error-tolerant replicator quasispecies. Lacks experimental validation; equating single-strand radiolytic breaks to point replication mutations is physically unvalidated.

models.uncertainty: Observation metadata (exact coordinates, observation date, voucher specimen ID, underside hymenophore) unknown; Pleurotus cystidiosus complex / Antromycopsis macrocarpa identification unconfirmed; matrix composition and sink rate constant k_M unmeasured.
models.known_limitations: Exploratory research candidate only (R6A). Does not establish taxonomic identity, identify pigment as melanin, demonstrate ROS quenching, establish radiation protection, or support radiation-associated energy transduction. Distinguishes general surface-matrix field M_surf from melanin-specific chemistry, requires one named reactive species C_R and 7 preregistered controls (C1 to C7), and does not modify Biofilms or couple to Oklo transport results.
